content: getUserMedia() requires a secure context (HTTPS or localhost) and explicit per-session user permission; browsers show a persistent in-use indicator. Best practice: explain why camera access is needed before prompting, always call track.stop() on all MediaStreamTracks when done to release the camera/hardware indicator and save resources, never keep streams open longer than needed, and handle permission-denied gracefully with a clear message rather than a raw console error. Cross-origin iframes and some private/incognito modes (notably Safari) impose extra restrictions.
